# Aathif Jameel PM - Freelance AI, Full-Stack & Mobile App Developer

> Freelance software engineer specializing in production AI systems (RAG, LangGraph agents, LLMs), full-stack web applications (React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL), and cross-platform mobile apps (React Native, Expo, iOS/Android). Available remotely worldwide for startups, SMBs, and product teams.

## Core Services & Positioning

- **Freelance AI Developer**: Custom AI applications, RAG search pipelines, multi-agent LangGraph workflows, Gemini/OpenAI integrations, answer evaluation systems, and vector search (pgvector/FAISS).
- **Freelance Full-Stack Developer**: End-to-end web product development, SaaS MVPs, enterprise ERP platforms, REST APIs, database schema optimization, authentication, and cloud deployment.
- **Freelance Mobile App Developer**: Cross-platform iOS and Android apps with React Native and Expo, offline-first SQLite caching, in-app purchases (Apple IAP, Google Play Billing, Razorpay), and EAS deployment.

## Key Production Proof & Case Studies

- **Unified Students Insight Platform**: Served 10,000+ students and 450+ faculty across 9 academic departments; reduced MySQL query latency by 40% (portfolio-reported scale metric).
- **Thozhan AI**: Production AI exam-prep platform live on Google Play Store and web (thozhan-ai.com); features Gemini handwritten evaluation, pgvector RAG, SM-2 spaced repetition, and 3-gateway billing (Razorpay, Apple IAP, Google Play Billing).
- **Genuine Engineering ERP**: 19-stage manufacturing approval workflow with role-based access control (RBAC), audit trails, Prisma, Supabase PostgreSQL, and Cloudflare R2 file attachments.
- **HaulTracker**: Offline-first freight broker CRM with IndexedDB caching, background sync queues, AES-256-GCM phone encryption, and Razorpay subscriptions.
- **NS Giftings**: B2B corporate gifting platform reaching #1 branded Google search ranking during launch.
- **MedAgent**: 5-agent LangGraph diagnostic pipeline supporting 5 LLM providers with IBIS structured reasoning (project-reported HDCC validity 98% -> 100%).
- **PaperBrain**: Source-attributed document RAG application with LangChain, FAISS, and sentence-transformers (~21ms project benchmark latency).
